## Circos overview

```{r circos-plot, fig.align='center'}
#| echo: false
if (!is.null(circos_tmp) && file.exists(circos_tmp)) {

  img_b64 = base64enc::base64encode(circos_tmp)

  # The density track's y ceiling, recomputed the way draw_circos() sets it (same inputs,
  # same helpers in R/parse_smallvariants.R), so the caption can name it
  dens_cap = tryCatch({
    lens = chrom_lens[names(chrom_lens) %in% chromosomes]
    if (!is.null(snv_circos) && nrow(snv_circos) > 0)
      circos_density_cap(bin_snv_density(snv_circos, lens[chromosomes[chromosomes %in% names(lens)]],
                                         CIRCOS_SNV_BIN)$per_mb) else NA
  }, error = function(e) NA)

  # HTML legend — four groups, swatches use --circos-* CSS vars (the density fill has no
  # var: it is DENSITY_COLOUR in R/circos.R, as a literal)
  sv_items = list(
    list(label = "INS", var = "--circos-sv-ins"),
    list(label = "DEL", var = "--circos-sv-del"),
    list(label = "INV", var = "--circos-sv-inv"),
    list(label = "DUP", var = "--circos-sv-dup")
  )
  cnv_items = list(
    list(label = "Major", var = "--circos-cnv-major"),
    list(label = "Minor", var = "--circos-cnv-minor"),
    list(label = "Total", var = "--circos-cnv-total")
  )

  make_items = function(items, swatch_type) {
    lapply(items, function(x) {
      tags$div(class = "circos-legend__item",
        tags$span(class = paste0("circos-swatch--", swatch_type),
                  style = paste0("--_swatch: var(", x$var, ")")),
        x$label
      )
    })
  }

  # Driver labels (assets/js/circos_drivers.js) go in an overlay sharing the image's viewBox;
  # anchors and geometry come from draw_circos(), the label rows from circos_driver_rows()
  geom = if (!is.null(circos_res)) circos_res$geometry else NULL
  anchors = if (!is.null(circos_res)) circos_res$anchors else NULL
  has_labels = !is.null(geom) && !is.null(anchors) && nrow(anchors) > 0
  # js_quote() escapes only double quotes: keep the free-text column to one safe line
  lab_rows = circos_labels[label %in% anchors$gene]
  if (nrow(lab_rows) > 0)
    lab_rows[, alteration := gsub("</", "<\\/", gsub("[\\\\\r\n\t]+", " ", alteration), fixed = TRUE)]
  drivers_js = if (has_labels) tags$script(HTML(paste0(
    "window.CIRCOS_DRIVERS = {geom: {",
    paste(sprintf("%s: %s", names(geom), vapply(geom, js_num, character(1))), collapse = ", "),
    "},\n  anchors: ", js_rows(anchors, c("gene", "theta", "x", "y")),
    ",\n  rows: ", js_rows(lab_rows,
                          c("label", "group", "genes", "panels", "tier", "type", "alteration")),
    "};"))) else NULL
  # No viewBox in the markup: circos_drivers.js sets it from geom (Quarto lowercases
  # attributes on markup it processes, and an SVG `viewbox` is ignored)
  plate = tags$div(class = "circos-plate",
    tags$img(src = paste0("data:image/svg+xml;base64,", img_b64), alt = "Genome circos plot"),
    if (has_labels) tags$svg(class = "circos-drivers", `aria-hidden` = "true")
  )

  # Plate and legend side by side (.circos-figure grid); the track order is the caption
  tags$div(class = "circos-figure",
    drivers_js,
    tags$figure(class = paste("circos-container", if (has_labels) "has-driver-labels"),
      plate,
      if (has_labels) tags$p(class = "circos-drivers-hint report-figure__caption",
                             "Tick a gene list to label its tier 1–2 findings."),
      tags$figcaption(class = "report-figure__caption",
        if (has_labels) "Gene labels: the tier 1–2 key findings of the ticked gene list(s), bold for tier 1.",
        "Tracks, outer to inner: ideogram · SNV density · SV · copy number.",
        if (!is.null(circos_cn))
          paste0("Copy number: ", { l = c(wakhan = "Wakhan rank-1 haplotype-resolved segments (major / minor = the higher / lower haplotype)",
                                          ascat = "ASCAT allele-specific segments")[circos_cn$source]
                                    if (is.na(l)) circos_cn$source else l },
                 ", the source of the overview's purity / ploidy and gene-level calls; capped at 4.")
        else "No copy-number segments were found, so the copy-number ring is empty.",
        # One string: adjacent tagList members render with a space, which would orphan the "."
        paste0(sprintf("SNV density is the number of somatic single-nucleotide variants per %s window",
                       fmt_bp(CIRCOS_SNV_BIN)),
               if (!is.na(dens_cap))
                 sprintf(" (axis capped at %s per Mb, the 99th percentile of non-empty windows; denser windows are clipped).",
                         formatC(dens_cap, format = "d", big.mark = ","))
               else "."),
        "Substitution types are shown in the",
        tags$a(href = "#mutational-signatures", "Mutational signatures"), "section."
      )
    ),
    tags$div(class = "circos-legend",
      tags$div(class = "circos-legend__group",
        tags$div(class = "circos-legend__title", "Small variants"),
        tags$div(class = "circos-legend__item",
          tags$span(class = "circos-swatch--bar",
                    style = "--_swatch: #6b655c; height: 8px; border-radius: 1px;"),
          "Mutation density (per Mb)"
        )
      ),
      tags$div(class = "circos-legend__group",
        tags$div(class = "circos-legend__title", "Structural variants"),
        make_items(sv_items, "bar")
      ),
      tags$div(class = "circos-legend__group",
        tags$div(class = "circos-legend__title", "Copy number"),
        make_items(cnv_items, "bar")
      ),
      tags$div(class = "circos-legend__group",
        tags$div(class = "circos-legend__title", "Translocation"),
        tags$div(class = "circos-legend__item",
          tags$span(class = "circos-swatch--arc",
                    style = "--_swatch: var(--circos-bnd)"),
          "BND link"
        )
      )
    )
  )

} else {
  section_notice(paste("Circos plot could not be generated. Check that ASCAT and Severus",
                       "output files are present."), warn = TRUE)
}
```
